moments.text: Wide infrared view: crosshair, red ring and corner brackets over grey, lighter at top; a small bright spot drifts right near the right edge.
The view jumps to an even grey; a tiny speck passes above the ring from right to left, then settles inside it.
A few dark frames as the sensor zooms in; the corner brackets disappear.
Three small white oval spots in a tight row sit just above the ring and wander around above the crosshair, keeping the same spacing.
The row of three drops to crosshair level and hovers near the ring's left side, dipping below it around 1:52, then back above.
